description:
This endpoint updates the permissions of a Member identified by the `userId`. 
This endpoint can also be used to move a Member between Permission Groups within a Product.
Only a single Permission Group can be set per Product.

isAdmin.description: Indicates that the member must be Organization Admin.

isBillingManager.description: Indicates that the member must be Billing Manager.

permissionGroupIds.description: List of Permission Group identifiers to where the Member should be added.

removeFromPermissionGroupsWhereIdNotSet.description: When `true`, the member will be removed from those Permission Groups that are not listed in the `permissionGroupIds` field.

name: update-member-permissions
